We and selected third parties use cookies or similar tracking technologies to store and/or access information on your device for technical purposes. You can freely provide, manage or withdraw your consent to the use of these technologies at any time through our Cookie Preferences Center or prevent their use by clicking “Deny” below.

About

This website uses certain monitoring and tracking technologies such as cookies, beacons, pixels, tags, and scripts (collectively, “Trackers”). These technologies help provide, maintain, and improve Papaya Global’s website, optimize our offerings and marketing activities (including by serving personalized ads), and enhance your experience. If you enable “Marketing” Trackers below, third parties, including social media platforms and advertising networks, may use the data collected for their own advertising purposes.
For more information on how Papaya Global uses Trackers, please refer to our Cookie Policy.

Necessary Trackers do not require your consent. You can accept, decline, or customize other Trackers at any time through the cookie settings below.

Papaya Global meets the highest international security and privacy standards, including SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and GDPR.
Papaya Global’s payment services are offered through Azimo, Papaya’s licensed payments arm. Azimo is a payment services provider regulated in five Tier-1 jurisdictions.
These licenses allow Papaya, together with its partners, to provide workforce payments worldwide. For further information on Azimo’s licences worldwide, check our licensing page.
